random_draft_monte_carlo.approximation: Mirrors draft roll legality using real roll pools, real generated players, slot compatibility, club-decade rolls, duplicate player_id blocking, and random legal slot assignment. It approximates a neutral user by choosing uniformly among valid rolls, available players and valid slots; UI sorting is intentionally ignored.

league_threshold_audit.approximation: Synthetic fixed-strength 11-player lineups; bucket strengths are player-rating percentiles from public/data/players.json. Production simulateSeason and evaluateAchievements are invoked.
